# Data dictionary

**All data in this folder is synthetic.** It is generated by `python -m src.data.generate --seed 42` from yard profiles and a documented data-generating process (DGP) in `config/assumptions.yaml` (`dgp` and `yards` sections). It contains no real animal, yard or company records. Licence: free to share with the submission.

- **Unit:** arrival cohort (lot), meaning cattle received together and housed as a group.
- **Files:**
  - `historical_cohorts.csv`: 1,400 past lots, Jan 2024 – Oct 2026, with 45-day outcomes.
  - `current_arrivals.csv`: 24 lots arriving 16–20 Nov 2026, the decision set. It has no outcomes.

**Availability** says when the value is known: D0 = at arrival or processing; D45 = only after the 45-day window.

| Column | Type / unit | Definition | Availability | Generation rule (synthetic) | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| lot_id | text | Unique lot identifier (H = historical, C = current) | D0 | sequential | - |
| yard | A/B/C/D | One of four yards with different profiles (see assumptions.yaml) | D0 | weighted draw | ASM scenario |
| arrival_date | date | Date received | D0 | uniform over period | - |
| arrival_quarter | Q1–Q4 | Calendar quarter of arrival | D0 | from date | Rojas 2022 used quarter |
| head_count | head | Head in lot at arrival | D0 | lognormal, median 130, 40–320 | ASM |
| arrival_weight_lb | lb | Mean arrival weight | D0 | normal by yard (Q4 −40 lb) | NAHMS 2019 weight classes; Rojas 2022 |
| sex | steer/heifer/mixed | Sex composition | D0 | draw by source | Rojas 2022; Weber 2024 (mixed lots at higher risk) |
| source_type | ranch_direct/backgrounded/auction | Procurement channel | D0 | yard source mix | Adekunle 2026b (commingling, transport) |
| n_sources | count | Number of origin herds commingled | D0 (often missing) | 1 / 1–3 / 2+Poisson(5) | Adekunle 2026b |
| transit_hours | h | Haul duration | D0 (often missing) | gamma by yard mean | Adekunle 2026b |
| vacc_history | known/unknown | Whether pre-arrival vaccination history is documented | D0 | probability by source | Adekunle 2026a |
| shrink_pct | % | Transit shrink (pay weight vs arrival weight); a nutrition and dehydration indicator | D0 (often missing) | normal, rises with transit | ASM |
| pen_area_m2_per_head | m²/head | Home-pen area per head | D0 | normal(18, 4) | Rojas 2022 pen variables |
| bunk_cm_per_head | cm/head | Linear bunk space per head | D0 | normal(30, 5) | Rojas 2022 pen variables |
| weather_stress | low/moderate/high | Forecast weather stress for arrival week | D0 | season- and yard-dependent | ASM; Adekunle 2026b (environmental domain) |
| metaphylaxis_given | 0/1 | Lot received arrival metaphylaxis (historical only) | D0 | 85% if <700 lb, 10% otherwise | ASM (historical discretion) |
| brd_cases_45d | head | Head with ≥1 BRD treatment within 45 days on feed | D45 | Binomial(head, p) | case definition from Rojas 2022 |
| morbidity_45d | proportion | brd_cases_45d / head_count | D45 | derived | Rojas 2022 |
| high_risk | 0/1 | morbidity_45d ≥ 0.15 | D45 | derived | Rojas 2022 cut-off |

## Missing data
Missingness depends on the source, as in real records, where sale-barn lots have the worst paperwork:

| Field | P(missing), auction lots | P(missing), other lots |
|---|---|---|
| transit_hours | 30% | 8% |
| n_sources | 35% | 5% |
| shrink_pct | 25% | 20% |
| pen_area_m2_per_head | 10% | 10% |

The model never drops these lots. Missing values are imputed many times from similar historical lots (same yard and source), and missing-indicator columns enter the model. A lot with **2 or more of transit_hours, n_sources and shrink_pct missing** is labelled **insufficient data**, and the optimizer will not reduce its antimicrobial protection below the current approach.

## Outcome-generating process (summary)
The untreated 45-day morbidity logit is a linear function of the arrival variables above (coefficients in `config/assumptions.yaml › dgp`), plus a yard effect and an **unobserved lot effect (SD 1.3 on the logit scale)**. The unobserved effect stands for everything a yard does not record. It keeps the model's discrimination near published levels. Historical lots that got metaphylaxis have their morbidity multiplied by (1 − 0.45). Observed cases are drawn as Binomial(head, p).

Calibration targets: mean observed morbidity of about 11% (between Rojas 2022's 6.3% and NAHMS 2011's 21.2%). About 26% of lots are above the 15% cut-off.

**Deviation to disclose:** Rojas reports 10.85% high-risk prevalence. Our higher prevalence (a fall-heavy, sale-barn-heavy demo week and operation) raises the synthetic PPV, so the synthetic PPV (0.70 on the 2026 temporal hold-out, at a sensitivity of 0.37) is **not** comparable with Rojas's 11–25%. Temporal hold-out synthetic AUC is 0.82 (0.71–0.83 for a yard left out), slightly above the published 0.68–0.79, because the generator includes predictors Rojas lacked (source, transit, vaccination history).

## What this data can and cannot support
- **Can:** demonstrating the full workflow (risk → options → consequences → feasibility), how missing records are handled, how constraints bind, and sensitivity analysis.
- **Cannot:** any claim about real-world predictive accuracy, about real intervention effects, or about these four yards' actual performance. Every model metric on this data is circular.

## Days 1–14 check-in input
| Variable | Unit | Definition | Available | Demo values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pulls_to_date | head | Animals in the lot given a first BRD treatment from arrival up to the chosen day on feed (1–14). Blank = not recorded. | D1–D14 | **Synthetic**: one plausible lot morbidity is drawn from the arrival risk prior (model draws plus lot-level dispersion) and pulls are drawn as Binomial(head, morbidity × day/21) (beta-binomial only if the `pen_clustering_icc` sensitivity input is raised above its default of 0), seed 150 (`src/decision/followup.py::simulate_pulls`): its day-7 total (123 pulls) is close to the median over 200 seeds (120), so the demo is typical rather than favourable. Not real records. |
